Product designer at heart, where product keeps flipping to founding, graphic, web, digital, lead, full-stack, motion, cat-approved and front-end." width="100%"></picture>

Based in Toronto, I'm currently a Lead Product Designer @ RBC Wealth Management, making self-directed investing approachable for everyone. Over the past several years, I've been leading design for both traditional and on-chain financial products. I work end-to-end, from defining the problem to designing the experience and getting it to a production-ready(ish) state.
